tasks.title: Conversation #37
tasks.transcript:
Man: Going to the farmers market on Saturday?
Woman: Yes, I need to pick up some fresh vegetables.
Man: Me too. I love the produce there. I wish it were closer to downtown though.
Woman: Yeah, changing two bus lines is a bit much.
Man: Maybe let's try to recruit Michael and Sarah to come with us. Taking a rideshare wouldn't be so expensive if we split the fare among the four of us.
Woman: That's a thought. Though I'm pretty sure the two of them are going to a wedding this Saturday.

questions.stem: What do the speakers dislike about the farmers market?

options.B: Its supply of vegetables is limited.
options.C: It is often closed on Saturdays.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问说话者不喜欢农贸市场的哪一点，属于细节题，需抓住对话中负面评价的核心信息。 选项分析 选项 A：定位原文“Man: Me too. I love the produce there. I wish it were closer to downtown though. Woman: Yeah, changing two bus lines is a bit much.”正确。男士提到希望离市中心更近，女士说要换乘两条公交，说明位置不方便，是对原文的准确同义转述。 选项 B：错误。对话未提及蔬菜供应有限，属于凭空捏造信息的干扰项。 选项 C：错误。两人计划周六去，说明周六正常营业，属于信息错误的干扰项。 选项 D：错误。文中只说拼车会便宜，未说市场东西贵，属于细节错位的干扰项。

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention a wedding?

options.A: To make a point about rideshare prices
options.B: To explain why she needs to buy vegetables
options.C: To invite the man to an event
options.D: To identify a problem with the man's plan

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士提到婚礼的原因，属于功能/组织结构题，需定位女士回应男士提议的关键内容。 选项分析 选项 A：错误。婚礼与拼车价格无关，属于无中生有的干扰项。 选项 B：错误。女士买蔬菜是去市场的目的，和婚礼无关，属于信息错位的干扰项。 选项 C：错误。女士并未邀请男士参加活动，属于细节曲解的干扰项。 选项 D：正确。男士提议叫上 Michael 和 Sarah 拼车，女士说他们要去婚礼，指出了计划的问题，与选项表述一致。
